# 5. The common joint eraser: an explicit parameter order

Define
\[
X=
2+\lceil M\rceil+\lceil\nu^{-1}\rceil+\lceil\rho^{-1}\rceil
+\lceil\tau^{-1}\rceil+\lceil\epsilon^{-1}\rceil.
\]
Then \(X\le2R\). Set
\[
q=2^{-20}c_*X^{-10},
\qquad
K_0=16C_*(M+1),                                                  \tag{5.1}
\]
and choose
\[
a=\left\lceil\frac{2^{20}K_0}{\rho\tau q}\right\rceil,
\qquad g=\rho a^2.                                               \tag{5.2}
\]

The amplitude is chosen before the short macro time. This prevents a circular choice between enhanced diffusion and local stability.

Calculate \(\Gamma\) from (1.3), and set
\[
T=\min\left\{\frac{\tau}{100},\frac1{100\Gamma},\frac1{100g}\right\},
\qquad
\mathcal J=\frac{100\Gamma}{T^2}.                                \tag{5.3}
\]
The envelope \(\Gamma\) is fixed large enough that \(\mathcal J\) bounds the kernel integral in (3.9).

Next set
\[
r=\frac{q}{100\Gamma\mathcal J K_0},
\qquad
r_0=\frac{r}{100\Gamma^2},
\qquad
K_\star=100\Gamma K_0,                                          \tag{5.4}
\]
\[
\beta=
\min\left\{\frac1{1000},\frac{gT}{10^6\Gamma^8}\right\},           \tag{5.5}
\]
and
\[
h=
\min\left\{
\frac{T}{1000},
\frac{gT^2}{10^6\Gamma^8},
\left(\frac{r}{10^6\Gamma^8K_0^2}\right)^8
\right\}.                                                       \tag{5.6}
\]

After each of the twelve excursions, insert the reset of Section 4, taking its two time caps to be \(\beta h/100\). Denote its total duration by \(d=\delta+\sigma\). Then
\[
d\le\beta h/50.
\]

A microcycle has actual length
\[
\ell=12(h+d).
\]
Set
\[
m=\lfloor T/\ell\rfloor,\qquad T_b=m\ell.
\]
The first bound in (5.6) ensures
\[
m\ge4,\qquad T/2\le T_b\le T.                                   \tag{5.7}
\]

The estimates in Section 3 and choices (5.5)–(5.6) give, with room for the later lowering error,
\[
\|S(T_b,0)\|_{H^1\to H^1}
\le 1-\frac{gT_b}{16}.                                          \tag{5.8}
\]

Repeat this macro
\[
n_b=\left\lceil\frac{256K_0}{qgT_b}\right\rceil                  \tag{5.9}
\]
times. Then
\[
\|S(n_bT_b,0)\|_{H^1\to H^1}\le\frac{q}{16K_0}.                 \tag{5.10}
\]
Also,
\[
n_bT_b\le \frac{256K_0}{qg}+T,
\]
which, by (5.2), is less than a fixed small fraction of \(\tau\).

Run the initial reset first, with budget \(\tau/32\). Its endpoint satisfies the entrance conditions for this schedule.
